command:
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
git fetch origin main work/search-v3-criteria --no-tags --prune
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "fetch failed" }
if ((git rev-parse origin/main).Trim() -ne "433e26a5278af97be4c58edc362549d52abf778a") { throw "main moved" }
if ((git rev-parse origin/work/search-v3-criteria).Trim() -ne "13e4f1fd2b647ba4d9f24d2b7c19fa296cf2047b") { throw "candidate moved" }
git checkout work/search-v3-criteria
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "checkout failed" }
if (-not (Test-Path "out\winui\Release\flyExplorer.exe")) { throw "candidate Release binary missing" }
@'
from pathlib import Path
import ctypes as c, os, shutil, subprocess, tempfile, time
from ctypes import wintypes as W
from PIL import Image, ImageGrab
from pywinauto import Desktop

root=Path(r"C:\dev\flyExplorer")
exe=root/"out"/"winui"/"Release"/"flyExplorer.exe"
before=root/"logs"/"remote-evidence"/"search-v3-before.png"
out=root/"logs"/"remote-evidence"/"search-v3-after-fixed.png"
assert exe.is_file(),exe
assert before.is_file(),before
target_size=Image.open(before).size
owned=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="search-v3-visual-",dir=root/"logs"))
folder=owned/"시각검토"
folder.mkdir()
(folder/"alpha.txt").write_text("owned",encoding="utf-8")
appdata=owned/"appdata"; localdata=owned/"localdata"; tmp=owned/"tmp"
for p in (appdata,localdata,tmp):p.mkdir()
profile=localdata/"flyExplorer"; profile.mkdir()
(profile/"ui-preferences-v1.txt").write_bytes(
    b"schema=2\r\nlanguage=ko-KR\r\ntheme=dark\r\nview=details\r\n")
env={**os.environ,"APPDATA":str(appdata),"LOCALAPPDATA":str(localdata),
     "TEMP":str(tmp),"TMP":str(tmp)}

u=c.windll.user32
CALL=c.WINFUNCTYPE(W.BOOL,W.HWND,W.LPARAM)
def hwnds(pid):
    found=[]
    @CALL
    def cb(h,_):
        owner=W.DWORD(); u.GetWindowThreadProcessId(h,c.byref(owner))
        if owner.value==pid and u.IsWindowVisible(h): found.append(int(h))
        return 1
    u.EnumWindows(cb,0); return found
def wait(fn,label,timeout=15):
    end=time.monotonic()+timeout
    while time.monotonic()<end:
        try:
            if fn(): return
        except Exception: pass
        time.sleep(.15)
    raise AssertionError(label)

p=subprocess.Popen([str(exe),str(folder)],cwd=exe.parent,env=env,
    stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
try:
    wait(lambda:bool(hwnds(p.pid)) or p.poll() is not None,"window missing")
    assert p.poll() is None,p.returncode
    hwnd=hwnds(p.pid)[0]
    width,height=target_size
    assert u.SetWindowPos(hwnd,0,90,45,width,height,0x0040)
    win=Desktop(backend="uia").window(handle=hwnd)
    wait(lambda:win.child_window(auto_id="SearchPanelButton").exists(timeout=.2),
         "search button missing")
    win.set_focus()
    win.child_window(auto_id="SearchPanelButton").click_input()
    for key in ("SearchMinSizeBox","SearchMaxSizeBox",
                "SearchModifiedAfterBox","SearchModifiedBeforeBox",
                "SearchPresetBox","SearchPresetNameBox"):
        wait(lambda k=key:win.child_window(auto_id=k).exists(timeout=.2),
             "missing "+key)
    rect=win.rectangle()
    img=ImageGrab.grab(bbox=(rect.left,rect.top,rect.right,rect.bottom),
                       include_layered_windows=True)
    img.save(out)
    assert img.size==target_size,(img.size,target_size)
    print("SEARCH_V3_FIXED_VISUAL_SIZE",img.size,flush=True)
    print("SEARCH_V3_FIXED_VISUAL_PASS",True,flush=True)
finally:
    if p.poll() is None:
        hs=hwnds(p.pid)
        if hs:u.PostMessageW(hs[0],0x0010,0,0)
        try:p.wait(timeout=10)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            p.kill();p.wait(timeout=5)
    shutil.rmtree(owned,ignore_errors=True)

'@ | Set-Content -Encoding UTF8 "logs\capture-search-v3-fixed.py"
python -X utf8 "logs\capture-search-v3-fixed.py"
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "fixed Search v3 visual capture failed" }
Write-Host "SEARCH_V3_FIXED_VISUAL_READY"
